test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Rs. 6000 is lent at the rate of 8 percent per annum on compound interest (compounded quarterly). What will be the compound interest of 6 months?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs.6000

Rate = 8% ; Time = 6 months

**Formula used:**

A = P × {1 + (R/100)}T

Compound interest (C.I) = A - P

Where, A = amount ; P = principal ; R = rate ; T = time

**Concept used:**

If interest is compounded quarterly, then

New rate = (R/4)% ;

New Time = T × 4

**Calculation:**

According to the question:

New rate = (8/4)% = 2%

New time = (6/12) × 4 = 2 years

Amount = P × {1 + (R/100)}T

⇒ 6000 × {1 + (2/100)}²

⇒ 6000 × {51/50}2

⇒ 6000 × {2601/2500}

⇒ Rs.6242.4

Compound interest (C.I) = 6242.4 - 6000 = Rs.242.4

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.242.4.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Calculation:

New rate = (8/4)% = 2%

New time = (6/12) × 4 = 2 years

Effective rate for 2 years = 2 + 2 + (2 × 2)/100

⇒ 4 + 0.04 = 4.04%

Compound interest (C.I) = 6000 × 4.04% = Rs.242.4

∴ The correct answer is Rs.242.4.
